verdict.rationale: JumpCloud documents a first-party HRIS integration that onboards new hires and removes departed employees 'with minimal manual intervention.' It can also import users from an HR system as the authoritative source and automate creation, access changes and termination across the lifecycle. The evidence is marketing-level only: mover handling is not tied to the HRIS, and automatic app-assignment changes driven by HR events are not described. Missing for 10: explicit HRIS-driven mover/attribute-change sync, documented automatic app assignment from HR events, named supported HRIS systems and mapping details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, HR drives identity — the HRIS is the source of truth, and joiner/mover/leaver changes flow into the directory and app assignments automatically

citations.quote: With JumpCloud’s HRIS integration, quickly and securely onboard new employees and remove those no longer employed with minimal manual intervention and lower risk of human error.
Create user accounts or easily import them from another authoritative identity source, such as your HR system or existing directory.
Automate identity creation, access changes, and identity and access termination throughout the identity lifecycle.
